title: Homepage typography implementation plan from psychology research
description:
Implementation plan for front-end homepage typography updates, grounded in research/font_presentation_and_psychology.md.

Scope
- Target files/components: front-end/src/features/home/pages/HomePage.tsx, front-end/src/features/home/components/HomeSection.tsx, front-end/src/features/home/components/ValuePillarsCarousel.tsx, and any directly related homepage typography classes.

Plan
1. Baseline typography audit
- Inventory current heading/body/CTA/navigation classes and map them to intended semantic levels (hero heading, section heading, section body, CTA labels, carousel card title/body).
- Record mismatches against research guidance: hierarchy via size first, then weight, with sparse emphasis.

2. Define homepage type scale + weight map
- Set body copy baseline to 16-18px with line-height ~1.5-1.7.
- Set clear heading steps: section heading ~28-32px (responsive), subheading/card title ~22-26px.
- Apply Source Sans weight rules: 400 body, 500 interactive/nav/labels, 600 section titles/high-priority labels, 700 only for rare critical callouts.

3. Apply emphasis policy
- Prefer size+weight for emphasis, not color-only emphasis.
- Keep italics only for secondary semantics; avoid italic as primary attention cue.
- Limit bold usage so emphasis remains meaningful.

4. Readability and accessibility safeguards
- Ensure normal text contrast >= 4.5:1 and large text >= 3:1 on homepage surfaces.
- Keep long lines near 50-75 characters for paragraph-like content where applicable.
- Validate desktop and mobile readability for dense sections (especially carousel overlays).

5. TDD and verification
- Add/adjust homepage typography tests first (failing), then implement styling updates.
- Verify test expectations assert behavior-visible typography decisions (class outputs, rendered hierarchy markers), not internal implementation details.
- Run full frontend test suite after each change set.

Acceptance criteria
- Homepage typography follows the defined scale/weight map and emphasis policy.
- Readability constraints (size, line-height, contrast intent, line length intent) are reflected in shipped classes.
- Existing homepage behavior remains intact and tests pass with new typography assertions.

description: Research and design an implementation for a smooth horizontal transition of the active/highlighted item in the homepage bottom navigation when the active section changes. Evaluate implementation options in the existing stack and identify the recommended approach with concrete code-level plan and test strategy.
design: Recommended approach: keep HomeFloatingNav and add a single animated active-indicator element (pill) positioned absolutely inside the nav list. Measure active item and container via refs and DOMRect, compute indicator x/width relative to container, and animate using transform+width transitions (CSS transition classes; motion-reduce disables animation). Preserve existing configured color tokens (bg-primary/text-primary-foreground) and keep inactive labels using current tokenized text color. Avoid new dependencies. Suggested structure: extract a pure helper to compute indicator metrics for testability; update HomeFloatingNav tests to assert indicator element/classes and add focused tests for helper math and reduced-motion behavior if implemented.
notes: Investigation considered shadcn options (tabs/toggle-group/navigation-menu). None provides the exact moving shared indicator behavior out-of-the-box for this nav; custom indicator implementation in existing component is the lowest-risk path.

The host's node_modules (which has react-router) is now used directly via the bind mount. Kept the root /app/node_modules anonymous volume since root isn't bind-mounted. (2) Added missing workspace package.json to each Dockerfile dev stage (back-end/package.json in front-end, front-end/package.json in back-end) so the startup bun install can resolve all workspaces. Also removed the now-unnecessary COPY of workspace node_modules from deps stage.

title: Fix root tsconfig TS6305 errors when running tsc from repo root
description:
## Problem
Running TypeScript directly against the root config fails even though workspace typechecks pass.

## Reproduction
1. From repo root, run `bunx tsc -b` (or `bunx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json`).
2. Observe many `TS6305` errors such as:
   - `Output file .../front-end/dist/App.d.ts has not been built from source file .../front-end/src/App.tsx`
   - Reason reported by TS: `Matched by default include pattern '**/*'`

## Current Behavior
- `bun run typecheck` passes because each workspace uses its own tsconfig.
- Root-level TypeScript invocation fails with `TS6305`, which breaks solution-style root checks and creates noisy IDE/CI behavior when root tsconfig is used.

## Scope
Adjust root TypeScript project configuration so it behaves as a solution config and does not accidentally include workspace source/output files via default include globs.

## Acceptance Criteria
- `bunx tsc -b` succeeds from repo root.
- `bunx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` succeeds from repo root.
- Existing workspace typecheck commands still pass.
- No regression in project references (`front-end`, `back-end`, `shared`).
acceptance_criteria:
- root TypeScript commands run cleanly from repo root
- no TS6305 errors from default include globbing
- workspace typecheck remains green
close_reason: Resolved by making root tsconfig solution-style and adding package eslint tsconfig files for test coverage

title: Articles page typography implementation plan from psychology research
description:
Implementation plan for front-end articles page typography updates, grounded in research/font_presentation_and_psychology.md.

Scope
- Target files/components: front-end/src/features/articles/pages/ArticlesPage.tsx, front-end/src/features/articles/pages/ArticlePage.tsx, and markdown/article typography surfaces used by these views.

Plan
1. Baseline typography audit
- Inventory sidebar category/article labels, breadcrumb trail, article title/description/meta/tags, and markdown body typography.
- Identify hierarchy or readability mismatches versus research guidance (scan efficiency and semantic emphasis).

2. Define articles-page hierarchy
- Establish clear heading steps (page title vs article title vs section headings).
- Enforce body baseline at 16-18px with line-height ~1.5-1.7 for article reading flow.
- Apply Source Sans weight rules consistently: 400 body, 500 navigation/interactive labels, 600 key headings, 700 only for rare high-salience callouts.

3. Optimize for scanning + comprehension
- Favor bold/weight changes for key inline emphasis instead of italics.
- Restrict italics to secondary semantic cues (quotes/terms), not primary emphasis.
- Ensure article text measure is near 50-75 characters where body text is displayed.

4. Accessibility + robustness
- Confirm breadcrumb, metadata, and body text satisfy contrast intent (4.5:1 normal, 3:1 large).
- Validate spacing does not regress readability on mobile and desktop article layouts.

5. TDD and verification
- Add/adjust tests first to capture typography behavior in article layouts, then implement.
- Run full frontend suite after each change set to prevent regressions in loading/error/selection states.

Acceptance criteria
- Articles list/detail surfaces follow consistent hierarchy and weight usage aligned with research.
- Reading ergonomics (text size, line-height, line length, emphasis sparseness) are implemented and test-covered.
- Existing article browsing behavior remains unchanged and tests pass.

description: Several backend tests hardcode hello-world slug/title and assume content/hello-world.md exists. Since production content changed, tests should be stable by creating their own temp markdown fixtures and asserting behavior rather than specific repository files.

title: Hide homepage bottom navbar on phone screens
description: Update the homepage bottom floating navigation so it is hidden on phone screens and only shown on larger breakpoints. Use existing responsive Tailwind classes/patterns in the project. Add or update tests to assert the responsive visibility behavior.

title: Add beige palette tokens to CSS theme
description: Add new beige light/dark theme variables to CSS using light #f3efe5 and dark #1c1a17 as requested.

title: Implement navbar icons for all homepage sections
description: Implement fitting icons for every section in the homepage navbar using the selected recommendation from research/icons.md after research is complete and user choice is confirmed.

title: Add React error boundary around MarkdownRenderer
description: If MarkdownRenderer throws during render, the entire page goes blank with no feedback. Wrap it in a React error boundary component that catches errors and shows a fallback UI (e.g. 'Failed to render content') instead of a blank page.

title: Replace all shorthand if expressions with if/else without behavior changes
description: Refactor all ternary shorthand conditionals (condition ? this : that) into explicit if/else statements across the codebase. IMPORTANT: this is a non-functional change; behavior must remain identical. Run tests to verify everything works as-is and no function behavior is altered.

title: Restructure articles split layout to edge-to-edge sidebar + divider
description: Remove the margin/card-shell layout from Articles page. Use an edge-to-edge split where sidebar sits on the left (~15% width on large screens), main content takes the remaining width, and a ~2px grey divider separates them.
